paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 15:19; perhaps it should read R' Nissi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ש״ר פ״טו-יט is expanded as Shemot Rabbah 15:19, the contextual work/parashah/section reading; no named edition is independently checked.
ואולי צ״ל introduces Hyman’s possible emendation: perhaps it should read Nissi. This is not a confirmed replacement for Nissim. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
